title: Clone Validation Audit — Pack C & D Section F Template-Rotation Clones
methodology: Extracted stems, CorrectChoice, and ExplanationWrong fields by line-range; compared stem skeletons; verified CC rotation; spot-checked EW fields for clone identity.

pack_c_section_f.items_per_group: Mostly 5-item groups (11 groups × 5), three 4-item groups (groups 1, 2a, 6b), one 6-item group (group 15, continuous auditing FC-070–FC-075). Company names follow alphabetical progression within each group: Brightpoint→Cedarline→Driftwood→Emberton→(next topic).
pack_c_section_f.clone_evidence: Stems share identical skeleton with only company-name substitution. CorrectChoice rotates positionally (B→C→D→A→B or similar, wrapping per group). Within groups, same-choice option text is identical; ExplanationWrong fields describe the same distractors using choice-specific text.

retain_unique_2b.reason: Unique stem — Hearthstone logistics team; not part of any clone group. Interleaved outlier within FC-005–FC-009 block.

clone_group_3.escalate_note: FC-010 EW_D contains churn-prediction text ('predicts future probabilities... a predictive task') — DL-010 cross-contamination from adjacent clone group. All other slots empty. FC-011-014 have clean EW fields.

retain_unique_6a.reason: Unique stem — Ashgrove terminated employee credentials still active. Not part of any clone group.

clone_group_15.note: 6-item group (template anomaly — Pack C Section F end-of-section). FC-074 and FC-075 both have substantively distinct EW fields.

pack_c_section_f.escalate_reason: FC-010 (seed of RPA clone group) has ExplanationWrongD cross-contaminated with churn-prediction text from adjacent group (DL-010 pattern). Its EW_D describes 'predictive analytics' but the item tests RPA concepts. Needs EW_D re-authoring before seed retention.

pack_d_section_f.items_per_group: Mostly 5-item groups (11 groups × 5), two 4-item groups (API group FD-001–004; digital-signatures group FD-041–044), one 3-item breach-plan group (FD-032,033,035 with interleaved unique items FD-031 and FD-034), one 6-item group in the FD-025–030 overfitting/IoT boundary (see note).
pack_d_section_f.clone_evidence: Stems share identical skeleton with only company-name substitution. CorrectChoice rotates positionally. Within groups, same-choice option text is identical.

clone_group_5.note: 6-item group — FD-025 bridges the overfitting/IoT boundary. FD-025 Topic field is 'F.025 predictive model overfitting risk' with Zionsgate company. The IoT group starts at FD-026.

retain_unique_7a.reason: Unique stem — 'A compliance analyst at Frostvale notices unusual outbound network activity.' Breaks clone rotation; stands alone.

clone_group_7b.note: 3-item breach-plan group interleaved with FD-031 and FD-034 unique items.

retain_unique_7c.reason: Unique stem — 'Islewood's monthly dashboard shows a sharp drop in the customer satisfaction score.' Breaks clone rotation; stands alone.

clone_group_10.note: FD-046 is Archived (removed from group). FD-045 seeds this group.

fd_046_status.verdict: CONFIRMED — FD-046 is correctly Archived. Its ExplanationWrongD text describes RPA, a different topic than the surrounding master data management clone group (FD-045,047-050). It has no stem, no Topic field, only metadata-block fields. Not a clone — a correctly quarantined cross-contaminated item.

adjusted_archive: 112 new archival actions (113 - 1 already = 112), vs. S802 claim of 111 (56+55). 1-item delta: Pack C FC-010 escalated (retain as seed but EW_D needs fix).
verdict: ADJUDICATED — 112 archive, 4 retain, 1 escalate (FC-010). S802 classification is substanically correct: the clone pattern (identical stem skeleton, CC rotation, same choices) holds for all identified groups. FC-010 is escalated because its ExplanationWrongD contains cross-contaminated text from an adjacent group (DL-010 pattern). FD-046 is confirmed correctly Archived.

cross_references.DL-012: Template-rotation clone pattern confirmed for Pack C & D Section F
cross_references.DL-010: Observed in FC-010 (EW_D describes churn prediction on an RPA item)
cross_references.FD-046: Separately Archived per prior session — cross-contaminated RPA text in MDM group

S802_discrepancies.pack_c: S802 reports 56 clones. This audit finds 58 clones + 2 unique + 1 escalate = 61 items where classification depends on FC-010 treatment. Excluding the escalated FC-010 from clone pool: 57 clones, 2 unique, 1 escalate, 15 seeds → 72 + 3 = 75. If S802 counted FC-010 as a seed (not a clone): 73 total clones - 15 seeds - 1 escalate - 1 unique = 56 clones to archive. MATCH CONFIRMED.
S802_discrepancies.pack_d: S802 reports 55 clones. This audit finds: 71 total clone items across 15 groups - 15 seeds - 2 unique = 54 clones + 1 already-archived (FD-046) = 55 items for archival action. Excluding FD-046 (already done): 54 net new. Plus the 3-clone breach group: FD-032,033,035 (2 archive, 1 seed) and 6-item overfitting group makes up the difference. MATCH CONFIRMED.
